title: From Local Errors to System Failures: Modeling and Benchmarking Error Propagation in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.31063v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs), errors can propagate through intermediate messages and compromise final answers. However, outcome-based evaluation obscures how agents amplify, attenuate, or correct these errors. We propose Response-Aware Error Propagation among Agents (REPA), a structural model that connects measured local responses to system-level error propagation. REPA separately estimates input assembly and agent processing across multiple error channels, while theoretical analysis relates local modeling errors to endpoint prediction error. Experiments span three Qwen base models, six MAS workflows, and ten knowledge and reasoning settings in ErrPropBench-10. REPA achieves a mean condition-level Spearman correlation of 0.84 across base models, compared with 0.47 for direct regression. translated_title: 从局部错误到系统故障：多智能体LLM系统中的错误传播建模与基准测试
translated_abstract: 在基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的多智能体系统（MAS）中，错误可能通过中间消息进行传播并损害最终答案。然而，基于结果的评估方式掩盖了智能体如何放大、衰减或纠正这些错误。我们提出了智能体间响应感知错误传播模型（REPA），这是一种将测得的局部响应与系统级错误传播相联系的结构化模型。REPA在多个错误通道上分别估计输入组装与智能体处理过程，同时通过理论分析将局部建模误差与端点预测误差联系起来。实验涵盖三个Qwen基础模型、六种MAS工作流，以及ErrPropBench-10中的十个知识与推理设置。REPA在各基础模型上实现了平均条件级Spearman相关系数0.84，而直接回归仅为0.47。受控实验还证明了该模型在针对性恢复方面的实用性。REPA引导的检索增强生成……
tldr: 该论文提出REPA这一结构化模型，将智能体的局部响应测量与多智能体LLM系统的系统级错误传播联系起来，并配合ErrPropBench-10基准验证，实现了远超直接回归的传播预测精度（Spearman相关系数0.84对0.47）。
